description: Find Medicare-certified hospices that serve a ZIP code (as reported to Medicare), or that have an office in a state, city or county, or by name, ranked by the family caregiver survey (CAHPS Hospice) star rating, the Hospice Care Index or name. Each result has the family survey stars (or the reason there are none), the share of caregivers rating it 9 or 10 and who would definitely recommend it, the Hospice Care Index (0 to 10), ownership, phone and the ccn for hospice_ratings.

county.description: County of the hospice office (needs state).

limit.description: How many hospices to return. Default 15.

min_stars.description: Minimum family caregiver survey star rating.

name.description: Hospice name or part of it.

sort.description: family_rating (default: stars, then would recommend), care_index or name.

state.description: State name or two-letter code (all hospices in the state, or narrows a ZIP, city or county search).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code where care is needed: lists every hospice that serves it. Best for "near me" questions.

name: hospice_search
title: Find and rank hospices
